profiles.label: Competitive
profiles.description: Turns Radeon Anti-Lag on while the game runs, to cut the time between your input and the frame it produces.

profiles.label: Smoothness
profiles.description: Caps the game's frame rate at the stream's, so the game does not render frames the stream drops and its frames arrive evenly.

profiles.label: Quality
profiles.description: Turns anisotropic filtering on and lets the driver enhance the game's own anti-aliasing. Costs GPU time, so it suits games that run well under the stream's frame rate target.

profiles.label: Custom
profiles.description: The Radeon settings listed for this game, and nothing else.
